evidence.ACL: Degeneration of ACL, MCL and proximal LCL
evidence.MCL: Thickening of MCL with increased interstitial signal inside MCL, ACL and proximal LCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of degeneration or grade 1 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in anterior and posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal
evidence.Medial OA: Osteoarthritis of left knee, major at patellofemoral joint and medial femorotibial joint
evidence.Lateral OA: major at patellofemoral joint and medial femorotibial joint
evidence.PF OA: Osteoarthritis of left knee, major at patellofemoral joint and medial femorotibial joint, with grade 4 chondromalacia.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: mild subchondral edema of left knee, major at medial femorotibial joint and patellofemoral joint.
